questions.q: What does Tanja draw in this video?
questions.e: In the video: "Danas crtamo u moj Art Journal, ili ilustrovani dnevnik" — today we're drawing in my art journal, or illustrated diary.

questions.q: When did she start keeping this diary?
o: Last year, when her daughter was very small
questions.e: In the video: "Ovaj dnevnik počela sam da vodim prošle godine" — I started keeping this diary last year.

questions.q: What will the drawings on this spread be about?
questions.e: In the video: "biće nešto sa vašara u Rumi" — it will be something from the fair in Ruma.

questions.q: Why did she need a narrow ladle?
o: It's prettier than the big one
So as not to scratch a narrow deep saucepan with a metal spoon
questions.e: In the video: "mi treba uža varjača da ga ne izgrebem metalnom kašikom" — I need a narrower ladle so as not to scratch it with a metal spoon.

questions.q: What is unusual about the lemon she saw?
o: It grows on a tree in a pot
questions.e: In the video: "narandžasti limun, koji ja nikad do sad nisam videla" — an orange lemon, which I'd never seen before.

questions.q: What was printed on Vuk's T-shirt?
questions.e: In the video: "odštampali štuku na majici" — they printed a pike on the T-shirt.

questions.q: Why does Tanja draw the lines in brown rather than black?
o: Black is too strong for delicate watercolor
questions.e: In the video: "Linije volim da radim u braon boji jer mi je crna suviše jaka za nežne vodene boje" — I like to do the lines in brown because black is too strong for delicate watercolors.

questions.q: What is actually inside the palette labeled "šminke"?
questions.e: In the video: "ali unutra nisu šminke, nego sam ja stavila Van Gogh vodene boje" — but inside it's not cosmetics, I put Van Gogh watercolors there.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Kupila sam usku *varjaču* na vašaru.
questions.e: Varjača — a ladle.

questions.q: Nacrtaću stvari sa *vašara* u Rumi.
questions.e: Vašar — a fair.

questions.q: On obožava *pecanje*.
questions.e: Pecanje — fishing, catching fish.

questions.q: Nekad su to *dosadne* stvari.
questions.e: Dosadan — boring. Don't confuse it with "dosta" — enough.

questions.q: Zabeležila sam jednu *uspomenu* iz života.
questions.e: Uspomena — a memory, a keepsake of something.

questions.q: Crna mi je *suviše* jaka.
questions.e: Suviše — too, excessively.

questions.q: Crna je jaka za *nežne* vodene boje.
questions.e: Nežan — delicate, tender.

questions.q: Pregledaću šta sam tamo *fotkala*.
questions.e: Fotkati — to photograph (colloquial, from "foto").

questions.q: Bavim se ___ i slikanjem.
questions.e: Baviti se + instrumental case: bavim se crtanjem.

questions.q: koji smo ___ sad za vikend, pa ću sad da pregledam
questions.e: A single completed visit — perfective posetili. Posećivali is imperfective (regular visits). Smo is plural.

questions.q: Varjaču sam kupila na ___.
questions.e: Na + locative case (where?): na vašaru.

questions.q: Dugo sam tražila varjaču koja nije ovakva, ova velika, tako da sam konačno ___
questions.e: "Finally" signals a result, so perfective: našla. A woman is speaking (tražila sam), so not našao.

questions.q: Boje koristim u ovoj ___.
questions.e: U + locative case (where?): u ovoj paleti.

questions.q: Obrisala sam linije grafitnom ___.
questions.e: With what? — instrumental case: grafitnom olovkom.

questions.q: Crna je suviše jaka ___ nežne vodene boje.
questions.e: Jak za nešto — "too strong for something": the preposition za.

questions.q: Idem napolje da šetam sa ___.
questions.e: Sa + instrumental case (with whom?): sa bebom.
